title: Climate Change (National Framework for Adaptation) Bill 2025
short_title: Climate Change (National Framework for Adaptation) Bill 2025

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: This bill would create a legal framework for the federal government to regularly assess climate risks and make long-term plans to adapt to them.
The Climate Change Authority would conduct a risk assessment every five years, and the minister would then set a national adaptation plan with strategies, funding and monitoring.
The framework requires all new bills in Parliament to include a statement on whether they are compatible with climate adaptation, and the federal budget must incorporate the cost of climate risk.
changes: Requires the minister to determine a National Adaptation Plan after each risk assessment.
Obliges the Authority to report annually to the minister on the plan's progress.
Mandates public release of climate change reports, including declassified versions of top-secret documents.
Introduces statements of compatibility for all new bills to assess climate adaptation consistency.
summary.affected: Australian communities, homes, businesses, infrastructure and the Australian economy.
